Projects.title: My Projects
Projects.description: All of them are live. Some were built for real clients, others came out of my own curiosity.

rngsport.description: Built for a team that shoots photo and video at rhythmic gymnastics tournaments. Athletes browse upcoming events on the tournament calendar and place a pre-booking for their shoot, which puts them on the shooting plan before the competition. Shoot packages and prints go into a cart and can be paid for on the site, while orders, galleries and memberships are handled from the panel behind it.

rangemedia.description: A marketing site for a social media and production agency. It presents their services and past work in two languages.

ritmikacup.description: A promotion and registration site for an international gymnastics tournament. The schedule, the categories and the sign-up all sit on a single page.

patimap.description: My university graduation project. A platform where anyone who spots a street animal can share its photo, location and condition. Registered users can add and manage their own posts, and every shared animal appears both as a list entry and at its location on a map. Alongside the site there is a mobile app that runs off the same account.

adabahce.description: A marketing site for a soilless farming producer. The content is kept up to date from the company's own panel.

ritmikacimnastik.description: A marketing site for a gymnastics club. It lists the programs, the coaching staff and the branches.

etadilat.description: A marketing site for a home renovation company. Every service they offer has its own detail page.

depon.description: A marketing site for a company working in distribution and dealerships.

furkankose.description: The site you are looking at. It gathers my projects, my skills and my contact details in one place.

Services.title: What I Do
Services.description: These are the four areas I usually work in. On most projects two or three of them come together.

list.title: Web Development
list.description: From marketing sites to ordering and booking systems. Sites that look right on a phone, load fast and can be found in search results.

list.title: Mobile Apps
list.description: Apps that run on both Android and iOS, set up to work off the same data as the web side.

list.title: Artificial Intelligence
list.description: Chat assistants, content generation, or text and image analysis, fitted into a project you already have.

list.title: Rebuilds, Maintenance and Support
list.description: Rewriting an outdated site from scratch, fixing speed and visibility problems, or adding new features to something already in production.
